items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And one guy would come up occasionally, Arv Garrison... he was a tremendous guitarist... I got a chance again to do some things that I wanted to do with guitars

ctx.x: Yeah, this is all we would do all night long, just play. And this went on for -- geez, a year.

And one guy would come up occasionally, Arv Garrison. I don't know whether you ever heard of him, but it was a Vivien Garry Trio of -- he was a tremendous guitarist from Toledo, I think. I think he was an epileptic or something, and he died. But he was a tremendous guitarist, he did some very nice things, real quick, you know, and then he went back to Toledo because he had this epilepsy. And I think he died. But he would come up occasionally, and this was a very important time in my life because I got a chance…
